stories.title: Provider Search Input/Output Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate the request/response schema for provider search including query text, location (state/city/zip), specialty filters (NUCC codes), and result structure (provider details, scores, distance). Ensure alignment with existing Pydantic models and facade contract.

stories.title: Core Provider Search Logic (Vector + Taxonomy Fallback)
stories.description: Implement core search orchestration combining MongoDB Atlas vector search with taxonomy-based fallback using NUCC codes. Include query embedding, ranking, fallback trigger conditions, and result merging.

stories.title: Find Care Facade Integration
stories.description: Integrate provider search service into the FindCare facade, ensuring proper orchestration with specialty identification, location handling, and tool routing compatibility for chat-driven execution.

stories.title: Provider Search API Exposure
stories.description: Expose provider search capability through FastAPI endpoint(s) or tool interface, ensuring request validation, error handling, and compatibility with chat-based tool invocation.

stories.title: Provider Search Testing and Integration Validation
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering schema validation, vector search execution, taxonomy fallback behavior, and end-to-end facade/API flows for provider search.
